legend.head: what the board’s colours and marks mean
legend.row.edges: your move · agent working · with the reviewers · nothing waiting, or a move of yours that can wait
legend.row.badges: you are the hold-up · yours whenever you like · red: what is waiting on you is broken
legend.row.flag: not flagged · flagged important by you, in this browser only; its row leads its group
legend.row.status: the state and its age · green: already on a shared branch
legend.row.deployed: already deployed — press again for what came after
legend.row.quiet: pressed, nothing new: the round read as unchanged or still waiting — until the card moves or you press it again
legend.row.request: the ticket · the request and how long it has been open · green ✓: approved
legend.row.checks: its checks: failed · passed · still running, or a retry pending. No dot: no pipeline, or nothing read it
legend.row.repos: where the board names projects, the name opens its request; across repositories, each name its own · ✓ approved
legend.row.drafted: replies were drafted since you last opened this tab — read them before you ship
legend.row.verdict: in a round’s replies: the verdict — green fixed · amber a question · grey pushed back — and the comment it answers
legend.row.stalled: stopped, yours to restart: nothing will look at this round again on its own, the state wearing it where no request is linked · in the header, the Master only judges until you press it · the whole board stopped, pressed to lift
legend.row.detail: the card’s own line: broken · your move
legend.row.yours: in the list: the tasks waiting on you, above the rest
legend.row.moved: in the list: bold, its state moved since you last had it open
legend.row.plan: in a plan or a diff: bold with a bar, new or changed since the plan you last approved · struck through, removed since
legend.row.rowverb: on a row: its most pressed verb, without opening the task · filled where that verb is your move
legend.row.verbkey: a verb’s key, drawn after its name · Done muted at the row’s end until hovered
legend.row.jobfailed: in the jobs: the last run failed, its age in red · its dot and a path check’s are the checks dot
legend.row.toast: a verb’s answer, passing: it ran · it was refused
legend.row.tabtitle: the tab’s title: how many tasks wait on you; its icon wears an amber dot, or red when something broke
legend.row.interruptions: in the header: how many cards are an interruption
legend.row.headerstate: in the header: nothing polls the requests · a job whose last run failed, pressed for the jobs · the Master presses the buttons you would · a role’s name, pressed: its log follows in the pane, pressed again, it hides
legend.row.headerbroken: in the header: this page is cut off from the backend, and nothing on it can run · the model provider failed repeatedly, so headless reads wait for one probe · jagt cannot reach a code host, pressed to log in, no card stops
legend.row.gear: in the header: the gear opens the settings dialog · Appearance (theme, auto following the system), Language and the jagt.yml settings; the chosen value carries a ✓, the theme and language are kept in this browser alone
legend.row.logentry: in every log: the time in UTC, muted, then the level and what happened; the newest entry is on top and a gap separates entries
legend.row.logfailure: in every log: a WARN or ERROR entry in red, a refusal or a failure
